manifest.name: dsh-token-board
manifest.description: DSH Web token board: animated activity summary above the account row, per-agent tok/s on session hover cards, this session's throughput in the conversation header, and a full Chinese usage-stats dashboard (heatmap, insights, skills, model share) opened from the footer row.
manifest.author: dsh-token-board contributors

bundle.text:
# dsh-token-board bundle patch: one host plugin row exposing the read-only
# token-throughput API that the client half polls.
- insert:
    - id: token-board
      name: dsh-token-board
      inject: [webServer]

readme.text:
[English](README.en.md) | 简体中文

DSH Web 实时 Token 看板：不再用悬浮窗罗列所有会话，而是把吞吐数据放到「就在你眼前」的位置，
点击侧边栏底部的概况行还会打开完整的「使用统计」面板（Token 活动热力图、活动洞察、技能与模型占比）。

| 位置 | 内容 |
| --- | --- |
| 侧边栏底部、账号行上方 | 三根绿/蓝/黄柱状图（有活动时依次跳动，空闲时灰色静止）+ 概况「N 会话进行中，X tok/s」；侧边栏收起为窄条时只显示图标，悬停弹出概况气泡 |
| 会话列表 hover 卡片底部 | 该会话当前进行中的主 Agent 与子 Agent 的实时 tok/s，前面带纯色状态圆点 |
| 会话标题栏动作区末尾（「N 个后台任务」右侧） | 当前打开会话的**整体吞吐**（主 Agent + 全部子 Agent 合计）；悬停展开全部 Agent 明细（暂停或 0 也计入）。计数器**紧贴右侧**的折线图图标在会话活动时每秒记录一个速度点，悬停显示本会话全部速度历史（详见下文「速度历史曲线」） |
| 点击底部概况行 | 打开完整「使用统计」面板：累计/峰值 Token、最长聊天、连续天数、Token 活动热力图（可选年份与配色主题，主题来自 calendar-heatmap design tokens 的 8 套方案；默认当前年全年格子，未来日期置灰不可 hover；每日/每周/每月/累计）、活动洞察、最常用技能、模型 Token 占比（每个模型标注提供方来源）；中文界面，自适应白天/黑夜 |

状态圆点沿用 dsh-token-hud 的语义，但使用本插件自己的纯色样式（无描边、无光晕）：

| 状态 | 颜色 |
| --- | --- |
| 出字中 streaming | 绿 `#34d399` |
| 等待模型 running | 黄 `#facc15` |
| 工具调用 tool | 蓝 `#60a5fa` |
| 重试等待 retrying | 橙 `#fb923c` |
| 空闲 idle | 灰 `#9aa0a6` |

readme.section: 界面截图：不同场景下的 Token 速度
readme.text:
**场景一：会话列表悬浮卡片** — 在侧边栏会话列表里把鼠标移到某个会话上，卡片底部会显示该会话当前进行中的主 Agent 与子 Agent 各自的实时 tok/s（下图中 `lead` 为 98.9 tok/s）。

**场景二：会话标题栏** — 打开某个会话后，标题栏动作区末尾（「N 个后台任务」右侧）显示本会话的整体吞吐（主 Agent + 全部子 Agent 合计）；鼠标悬停展开每个 Agent 的明细（下图中会话总吞吐 60.8 tok/s，`lead` 处于出字中）。

readme.section: 速度历史曲线（会话标题栏）
readme.text:
会话标题栏吞吐计数器**紧贴右侧**有一个折线图图标。客户端完全复用已有的 1s `/token-board/v1/stats` 轮询做**纯前端采样**：不新增请求、不落盘、不调用任何 LLM。

- 只有当前打开的会话**处于活动状态**（主/子 Agent 非空闲）时才记录；空闲的秒数不记录，曲线在空闲时段**断开**，而不是补 0；
- 每秒最多一个采样点；X 轴为时间，Y 轴为该会话整体吞吐（tok/s），曲线用 Catmull-Rom 转三次贝塞尔段**平滑**绘制；
- 历史只存在当前页面的内存里（每会话最多 7200 点，约 2 小时；刷新页面清空）；切换会话时各自的历史保留；
- 悬停/聚焦图标弹出面板，样式与吞吐悬浮面板一致，面板内每秒随轮询实时更新，显示采样数、峰值速度与时间轴。

要求：DeepSeek Harness Web profile（在 `0.2.2-alpha.2` 上开发并验证）、Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`。
插件无 npm 依赖、无构建步骤、无外部网络请求；数据全部留在本机。

**方式一：从打包文件安装（推荐分发给他人）**

```sh

readme.section: 把 dsh-token-board-0.1.0.tgz 拷到目标机器后：
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add /绝对路径/dsh-token-board-0.1.0.tgz

readme.section: 重启 dsh web（若 profile 已启用 HMR 会自动挂载，否则重启后生效），刷新页面
readme.text:
```

**方式二：从目录安装（开发/本地链接）**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/绝对路径/dsh-token-board
```

**方式三：Web 界面**：设置 → Plugins 页面安装本目录或 tgz。

安装后侧边栏底部账号行上方出现概况行；宿主只读端点：

- `GET /token-board/v1/stats` — 实时各 Agent 吞吐（内部轮询）
- `GET /token-board/v1/usage?from&to&timeZone` — 使用统计快照（面板用）

首次打开统计面板时会在后台建立本地索引（大历史约 10 秒级，面板不阻塞、先显示部分数据并自动补全），
索引文件位于 `$DSH_HOME/token-board/usage-index.json`，可随时删除以重建。

卸载：`dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-token-board`。

点击侧边栏底部（账号行上方）的「N 会话进行中，X tok/s」概况行即可打开「使用统计」面板，
右上角「← 返回对话」或 Esc 返回。统计口径与界面参考
[Zhang6177/dsh-token-usage-board](https://github.com/Zhang6177/dsh-token-usage-board) 的
「Usage Stats」页面（只复刻其总体统计 UI，不含调用明细/导出/过滤等额外功能），数据同样来自本机会话日志。

Host 侧通过 `sessionQuery` 读取会话日志并按会话缓存摘要到 `$DSH_HOME/token-board/usage-index.json`
（进程内 30s 刷新、只增量读取新会话与当前活跃会话）。端点采用 stale-while-revalidate：
打开面板永远先返回内存里的上次结果（毫秒级），索引/刷新全部在后台进行，不会阻塞页面；
面板在 `indexReady:false` 时自动短轮询补全。首次安装无缓存时先显示部分/空数据，
后台建立索引（约 10 秒级）完成后自动更新。
只读端点：`GET /token-board/v1/usage?from&to&timeZone`。

面板全貌（示例数据）：

Host 半边监听所有会话的 `session/event` 与（新版宿主的）逐 chunk 广播
`agent/assistant-stream`，用滚动窗口按字符数估算输出速度（中文 ≈1 tok/字，英文 ≈4 字符/tok），
并在 `assistant/message` 携带 provider usage 时校正为精确值。子 Agent 通过会话头部的
`parentSession` / `origin` / `delegationDepth` 归属到父会话，标题栏与 hover 卡片按「自身 + 全部后代」
聚合。纯内存、零持久化、不写会话日志。标题栏的速度历史曲线同样只在浏览器内存中累积（每秒 1 个活动采样点），
不发额外请求、不落盘，也不参与任何 LLM 调用。

> 客户端固定轮询 `/token-board/v1/stats`；`apiPath` 如需修改必须同时改 `lib/client.js`，否则三个界面都取不到数。

```yaml
- id: token-board
  config:
    apiPath: /token-board/v1   # 只读端点前缀（固定，客户端硬编码同值）
    windowMs: 5000             # 速度滚动窗口

- 速度是流式字符估算值（约 10% 级误差），provider 上报 usage 后校正。
- Host 重启后累计值清零；空闲超过 `idleTtlMs` 的 Agent 从明细中消失。
- 标题栏吞吐对「打开中的会话」生效；没有会话打开时该位置不显示。

测试依赖 DSH 源码 checkout 里的 jsdom/react（`DSH_CHECKOUT` 或默认路径），因此从源码工作区运行；
打包安装（`files` 不含 `test/`）不带测试。

```sh
node test/test-host.mjs     # host 逻辑：估算/状态机/谱系/窗口有界/HTTP
node test/test-usage.mjs    # 使用统计聚合：totals/streak/热力图/模型/技能/缓存/参数校验
node test/test-client.mjs   # client 冒烟：模块加载、四个插槽、三个实时组件 + 使用统计面板
```
MIT

[简体中文](README.md) | English

A realtime token board for DSH Web: instead of listing every session in a floating window, it puts throughput data right where you are looking; clicking the summary row at the bottom of the sidebar opens the full "Usage Stats" panel (token activity heatmap, activity insights, skill and model share).

| Where | What |
| --- | --- |
| Bottom of the sidebar, above the account row | Three green/blue/yellow bars (animating in turn while there is activity, static grey when idle) + summary "N sessions active, X tok/s"; when the sidebar is collapsed to a narrow rail only the icon remains, and hovering shows a summary popover |
| Bottom of the session-list hover card | Realtime tok/s of the session's active primary agent and subagents, each preceded by a solid status dot |
| End of the conversation header action area (right of "N background tasks") | **Overall throughput** of the currently open session (primary agent + all subagents); hover to expand the full per-agent breakdown (paused or 0 still counted). A **line-chart icon flush to the right** of the counter records one speed point per second while the session is active; hovering it shows this session's full speed history (see "Speed history chart" below) |
| Clicking the bottom summary row | Opens the full "Usage Stats" panel: cumulative/peak tokens, longest conversation, streak days, token activity heatmap (optional year and color theme; themes come from the 8 schemes of calendar-heatmap design tokens; defaults to the full current

The status dots follow the semantics of dsh-token-hud but use this plugin's own solid-color style (no outline, no glow):

| Status | Color |
| --- | --- |
| streaming | green `#34d399` |
| running (waiting for the model) | yellow `#facc15` |
| tool call | blue `#60a5fa` |
| retrying | orange `#fb923c` |
| idle | grey `#9aa0a6` |

readme.section: Screenshots: token speed in different scenarios
readme.text: **Scenario 1: session-list hover card** — move the mouse over a session in the sidebar session list; the bottom of the card shows the realtime tok/s of that session's active primary agent and subagents individually (in the screenshot `lead` is 98.9 tok/s).

readme.section: Screenshots: token speed in different scenarios
readme.text: **Scenario 2: conversation header** — open a session and the end of the header action area (right of "N background tasks") shows the overall throughput of this session (primary agent + all subagents); hovering expands the per-agent breakdown (in the screenshot the session total is 60.8 tok/s and `lead` is streaming).

A line-chart icon sits **flush to the right** of the conversation-header throughput counter. The client reuses the existing 1s `/token-board/v1/stats` poll for **purely client-side sampling**: no extra requests, no persistence, and no LLM calls.

Requirements: a DeepSeek Harness Web profile (developed and verified on `0.2.2-alpha.2`) and Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`.
The plugin has no npm dependencies, no build step and makes no external network requests; all data stays on the local machine.

**Option 1: install from a tarball (recommended for distribution)**

```sh

readme.section: after copying dsh-token-board-0.1.0.tgz to the target machine:
readme.text: dsh plugin --profile web add /absolute/path/dsh-token-board-0.1.0.tgz

readme.section: restart dsh web (if the profile has HMR enabled it mounts automatically, otherwise it takes effect after a restart), then refresh the page
readme.text:
```

**Option 2: install from a directory (development/local link)**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add link:/absolute/path/dsh-token-board
```

**Option 3: Web UI**: install this directory or the tgz from Settings → Plugins.

After installation the summary row appears at the bottom of the sidebar, above the account row. Host read-only endpoints:

readme.section: restart dsh web (if the profile has HMR enabled it mounts automatically, otherwise it takes effect after a restart), then refresh the page
readme.text:
- `GET /token-board/v1/stats` — realtime per-agent throughput (polled internally)
- `GET /token-board/v1/usage?from&to&timeZone` — usage-stats snapshot (used by the panel)

The first time the stats panel is opened it builds a local index in the background (about 10 seconds for a large history; the panel never blocks — it shows partial data first and fills in automatically). The index file lives at `$DSH_HOME/token-board/usage-index.json` and can be deleted at any time to rebuild it.

readme.section: restart dsh web (if the profile has HMR enabled it mounts automatically, otherwise it takes effect after a restart), then refresh the page
readme.text: Uninstall: `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-token-board`.

Click the "N sessions active, X tok/s" summary row at the bottom of the sidebar (above the account row) to open the "Usage Stats" panel; "← Back to conversation" or Esc returns. The metrics and UI follow the "Usage Stats" page of [Zhang6177/dsh-token-usage-board](https://github.com/Zhang6177/dsh-token-usage-board) (only the overall stats UI is reproduced, without call details/export/filtering and other extras); data also comes from local session logs.

On the host side, `sessionQuery` reads session logs and caches a per-session summary in `$DSH_HOME/token-board/usage-index.json` (in-process refresh every 30s, incrementally reading only new sessions and the currently active ones). The endpoint uses stale-while-revalidate: opening the panel always returns the previous in-memory result first (millisecond-level), while indexing/refreshing happens entirely in the background and never blocks the page; while `indexReady:false` the panel short-polls to fill in. On a fresh install without cache it shows partial/empty data first and updates automatically once the background index (about 10 seconds) completes.
Read-only endpoint: `GET /token-board/v1/usage?from&to&timeZone`.
The full panel (sample data):

The host half listens to every session's `session/event` and (on newer hosts) the per-chunk `agent/assistant-stream` broadcast, estimates output speed from a rolling character window (Chinese ≈ 1 tok/char, English ≈ 4 chars/token) and corrects it to the exact value once an `assistant/message` carries provider usage. Subagents are attributed to their parent session through `parentSession` / `origin` / `delegationDepth` in the session header, and the header and hover card aggregate "itself + all descendants". Purely in-memory, zero persistence, no session-log writes. The header speed-history chart likewise accumulates in browser memory only (one active sample per second); it issues no extra requests, persists nothing and never invokes an LLM.

> The client always polls `/token-board/v1/stats`; if you change `apiPath` you must also change `lib/client.js`, otherwise none of the three surfaces can fetch data.

```yaml
- id: token-board
  config:
    apiPath: /token-board/v1   # read-only endpoint prefix (fixed; the client hard-codes the same value)
    windowMs: 5000             # speed rolling window

- Speed is a streaming character estimate (roughly 10% error), corrected once the provider reports usage.
- Cumulative values reset when the host restarts; agents idle for longer than `idleTtlMs` disappear from the breakdown.
- Header throughput only applies to the open session; that position is hidden when no session is open.

The tests depend on the jsdom/react from a DSH source checkout (`DSH_CHECKOUT` or the default path), so they run from a source workspace; a packed install (`files` excludes `test/`) does not ship the tests.

```sh
node test/test-host.mjs     # host logic: estimation/state machine/lineage/bounded window/HTTP
node test/test-usage.mjs    # usage-stats aggregation: totals/streak/heatmap/model/skill/cache/param validation
node test/test-client.mjs   # client smoke test: module load, four slots, three realtime components + usage stats panel
```
